services.desc: The Student-Athlete Advisory Committee (SAAC) at Bowling Green State University strives to be the primary link between the student-athlete population and the athletic administration in order to enhance the experience of all student-athletes. As a leadership group, SAAC is dedicated to addressing the concerns of the student-athlete population, providing programs and events for student-athlete development and growth, encouraging the support of fellow Falcon student-athletes, and getting BGSU Athletics involved in both campus and community activities.
